name: hospital-ulianopolis
description: Sistema digital de atendimento — Hospital Municipal de Ulianópolis (recepção → triagem → fila médica → consultório → conduta)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hospital/api && npm run build -w @hospital/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @hospital/shared" "npm run dev -w @hospital/api" "npm run dev -w @hospital/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @hospital/shared && npm run test -w @hospital/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @hospital/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hospital/api && npm run lint -w @hospital/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @hospital/api && npm run typecheck -w @hospital/web
